encryption_details.algorithm: Repeating-key XOR: data[i] ^= key[i % 8], applied to 32 bytes of g_encrypted_dll_path
encryption_details.key_storage: Static 8-byte plaintext global g_xor_key in read-only .rdata at VA 0x140004000; ciphertext is the 32-byte g_encrypted_dll_path global in .data at VA 0x140003000

decoded_strings.note: This is the exact output produced by the binary's XOR routine and embedded key. It is not a syntactically valid DLL path, so the embedded payload path appears malformed or intentionally nonfunctional.

anti_analysis: Direct x64 PEB BeingDebugged check: reads PEB from GS:[0x60], tests byte at PEB+0x2, and exits WinMain early when set

Manual parsing of kernel32.dll's PE export directory to resolve injection APIs, keeping CreateToolhelp32Snapshot/OpenProcess/VirtualAllocEx/WriteProcessMemory/CreateRemoteThread out of the static import table
XOR-obfuscation of the prospective DLL path

injection_details.method: Classic remote-thread DLL injection: CreateRemoteThread with LoadLibraryA as the start routine
injection_details.target_discovery: Dynamically resolves CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, and Process32Next from kernel32.dll; creates a TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS (0x2) snapshot and performs a case-sensitive strcmp against PROCESSENTRY32A.szExeFile for explorer.exe
injection_details.process_open: OpenProcess access mask 0x42A (PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_OPERATION | PROCESS_VM_WRITE | PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD), handle inheritance disabled
injection_details.payload: The 32-byte g_encrypted_dll_path buffer is copied to the stack, XOR-decrypted with the static 8-byte key, and explicitly NUL-terminated. The resulting bytes are treated as an ANSI DLL path.
injection_details.payload_write: Computes strlen(path)+1, allocates that size in explorer.exe with VirtualAllocEx(NULL, size, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE/0x3000, PAGE_READWRITE/0x4), then copies the path including its NUL terminator with WriteProcessMemory
injection_details.remote_execution: Manually resolves LoadLibraryA from kernel32.dll and calls CreateRemoteThread(hProcess, NULL, 0, LoadLibraryA, remote_path, 0, NULL), then WaitForSingleObject(thread, INFINITE) and closes the thread/process handles
injection_details.api_resolution: GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll") followed by custom MZ/PE validation and IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY name/ordinal/function-table walking; API-name strings themselves are plaintext
injection_details.cleanup: Closes the Toolhelp snapshot, remote-thread handle, and target-process handle; does not call VirtualFreeEx
